lines.en: I move slowly with my cargo crates.

lines.zh: 我的轮子在碎石上打滑。
lines.en: My wheels slip on the gravel.

lines.zh: 我沿着大路走，不抄近道。
lines.en: I keep to the main road, never the shortcut.

lines.zh: 我推着小车，沿路慢慢走。
lines.en: I push my cart slowly along the road.
My rack of goods sways in the wind.

lines.zh: 我绕开水洼，货物不能湿。
lines.en: I go around puddles; the goods must stay dry.
I leave a wheel rut in the dirt road.
I head where there are people.

lines.zh: 我的引擎声像远处的蜂。
lines.en: My engine sounds like distant bees.

lines.zh: 我一路数着路边有多少岔口。
lines.en: I count every fork in the road.

lines.zh: 我转身时，货箱互相碰了一下。
lines.en: Turning, my crates knock together.

lines.zh: 我在天黑前要找一处过夜。
lines.en: I need a place to spend the night before dark.

lines.zh: 我慢慢靠近路口的那栋屋子。
lines.en: I ease up to the house at the crossing.
I only switch my lamps on at dusk.

lines.zh: 我停着，把自己收拾整齐。
lines.en: I stop and tidy myself up.
I go over my inventory list.

lines.zh: 我的显示器上滚着数字。
lines.en: Numbers scroll across my display.

lines.zh: 我调整了一下背上的箱扣。
lines.en: I tighten a crate strap on my back.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只手臂，对着风。
lines.en: I lift an arm to test the wind.
I'm waiting for someone to ask a price.

lines.zh: 我的装甲上有一道旧刮痕。
lines.en: There's an old scrape on my plating.

lines.zh: 我把掉下来的一块布塞回箱子。
lines.en: I tuck a fallen cloth back into a crate.
I check the axle once over.

lines.zh: 我的手很稳，不像战士的手。
lines.en: My hands are steady, not a fighter's hands.
I scrape the mud off my wheels.
I wait for the sun to climb a little.
Customer, what are you looking at?
You have things worth trading.
Let me lay my goods out for you.
That iron ingot in your hand is decent.

lines.zh: 我不问你来历，只谈价钱。
lines.en: I don't ask where you're from; only the price.
Are you buying or selling?

lines.zh: 我的护甲很厚，别担心我。
lines.en: My plating is thick; don't worry about me.
You've come a long way.
Is it safe here? I'd like to stop.
I only trade, nothing else.
Trading is paused; let me fix my shell.
I sway and the crates rattle.
My indicator has turned red.
I can still carry this damage.
I shift behind a stone at the roadside.
One wheel isn't turning well.
I shield the most valuable slot.
I'll log it and fix it later.

lines.zh: 这不是我的血，是液压油。
lines.en: That's not blood; it's hydraulic fluid.

lines.zh: 我还能站着，就能继续做生意。
lines.en: As long as I stand, I can keep trading.
Why are you showing me that?
My fuel tank is still full.

lines.zh: 食物在这条路上不保值。
lines.en: Food doesn't keep its value on this road.
Are you offering that for my goods?

lines.zh: 这个我可以收，但要便宜。
lines.en: I'll take that, but at a low price.
That's not worth much.
I only take what I can sell on.

lines.zh: 这个我不需要，你别举了。
lines.en: I don't need it; stop waving.
Tell me what you want in return first.
You've bumped my cargo crate.
Careful; there's fragile stock in there.

lines.zh: 我被你一顶，车晃了一下。
lines.en: One shove and my cart rocks.

lines.zh: 我的轮子卡进你的靴子。
lines.en: My wheel caught on your boot.
I back off and straighten the rack.
We're squeezed on this narrow road.
You stepped on my wheel.
Nothing fell off. Lucky.

lines.zh: 你靠得太近，我就走不快。
lines.en: Too close and I can't get moving.

lines.zh: 这行当里，一个人走更省事。
lines.en: In this trade, traveling alone is simpler.
I've met others of my kind on the road.
We swapped news of the roads.
It sells cloth; I sell iron.

lines.zh: 两个货箱并排，挡住了路。
lines.en: Two cargo racks side by side block the road.
We didn't travel together long.
Its wheels are newer than mine.

lines.zh: 我们讨价还价了半个下午。
lines.en: We haggled half an afternoon.
It turned around at the fork.
We agreed to meet again next year.
I can resell this.

lines.zh: 我把它放进最上面的箱格。
lines.en: I stow it in the top crate slot.
Iron scrap. Good stock.
When I bend, the crates tilt back.
This has some weight to it.
I weigh it and price it.
I don't pick up junk; this will do.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的，可能是别人的。
lines.en: What's on the ground might belong to someone.
I slip it into my pouch.
I add it to the list.

lines.zh: 我不惹事，但我也不会站着挨打。
lines.en: I don't start fights, but I won't stand and take hits.

lines.zh: 我的护甲五百点厚，你想清楚。
lines.en: Five hundred points of plating. Think it over.

lines.zh: 我往后退，找一处可以靠的地方。
lines.en: I back up toward something solid.
I don't attack; I only defend.

lines.zh: 你把武器收起来，我们就谈。
lines.en: Put the weapon away and we'll talk.

lines.zh: 我的扬声器会把声音放得很大。
lines.en: My speakers can get very loud.

lines.zh: 我这一车货不值你动手。
lines.en: This cartload isn't worth your trouble.
I see you. Don't pretend.
I put a crate in front of me.
I haven't decided whether to run.

lines.zh: 你要抢，就别怪我不客气。
lines.en: Rob me, and I'll stop being polite.
All I can do is defend myself.
My legs are heavy; I can't outrun you.
Clear the way and I'll roll my cart through.
I'll count to ten, then I'm leaving.
That's the last friendly word.
I've seen your coin purse.
Every step you take, I note it.
I turn the cart toward open ground.
You're hesitating; I can tell.

lines.zh: 我护着箱子，没有别的选择。
lines.en: I'm shielding the crates; I've no other choice.
I retreat slowly, but I keep retreating.
Your blade is still sheathed.
My sensors are fixed on you.
If you're going to do it, come from the front.
I hear you shifting your feet.

lines.zh: 我算过了，我们差不多重。
lines.en: I've calculated it; we're about even in weight.
There's still road behind you.
My engine is idling.

lines.zh: 我不喊，喊了会引来更多人。
lines.en: I won't shout; that only brings more of them.
I'd rather not lose this cartload.
My goods are all in the hold.
My mechanical arm folds across my chest.
My hull jolts you.

lines.zh: 这一下不是攻击，是防守。
lines.en: That wasn't an attack; that was a guard.
I put a crate between us.

lines.zh: 我的护甲吃掉了大半的力。
lines.en: My plating ate most of the force.
I fall back behind the cart.
I turn the cart across the road.

lines.zh: 这一下让我损失了一个箱子。
lines.en: That cost me one crate.
I'm guarding my goods and myself.
I'm getting ready to withdraw.
I push my cart up to the crossing.

lines.zh: 我的灯亮起来，开始营业。
lines.en: My lamps come on, and I'm open for business.

lines.zh: 我选了处背风的地方停下。
lines.en: I stop in a spot sheltered from the wind.

lines.zh: 这地方有商路，我可以待。
lines.en: There's a trade route here; I can stay.
I open the crates one slot at a time.

lines.zh: 我又走了很远才到这里。
lines.en: It took a long road to get here.
My wheels are caked in mud.
Where there are people, there's trade.
I shut the engine down to save fuel.
I set out my sign and wait.
The wind here is no joke.

lines.zh: 我身上刮痕不少，但都还在。
lines.en: Plenty of scrapes on me, all still holding.

lines.zh: 货箱着火了，我先扑这个。
lines.en: A crate's on fire; I put that out first.

lines.zh: 我从坡上翻下去，货撒了一地。
lines.en: I tip down the slope and spill my goods.

lines.zh: 水漫过底盘，我的动作变慢。
lines.en: Water reaches my undercarriage; I slow down.

lines.zh: 爆炸震得我的箱子都开了。
lines.en: The blast pops open every crate.
Shrapnel wedges into an armor seam.

lines.zh: 这种能量让我的显示乱了。
lines.en: That energy scrambles my display.

lines.zh: 油表见底，我只能慢慢挪。
lines.en: Fuel gauge near empty; I can barely crawl.

lines.zh: 雷打在我的天线上，整台发麻。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my antenna and my whole body buzzes.

lines.zh: 这里没有路，我的车轮空转。
lines.en: No road here; my wheels spin on nothing.
